ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Container Discovery Via Inodes Listing
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects listing of the inodes of the "/" directory to determine if the we are running inside of a container.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/ls$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-*i.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-*d.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/$"))
